subject: treeshrew on palm
title: This Tiny Animal Drinks Beer-Strength Nectar and Never Gets Drunk

scenes.text: This animal drinks alcohol at night and stays sober.
The pen-tailed treeshrew lives in the rainforests of Malaysia. Its bar is a plant called the bertam palm.
The palm's nectar ferments naturally, up to 3.8 percent alcohol. That's as strong as beer.
For its size, a treeshrew drinks like a person having nine glasses of wine in an evening.
Scientists tested its hair for a chemical trace of drinking. It was far higher than in lab rats that never touch alcohol.
Yet it never stumbles. And scientists think the palm is buying a pollinator, one drink at a time.

description:
The pen-tailed treeshrew of Malaysia regularly drinks fermented palm nectar without getting drunk.
The nectar of the bertam palm ferments naturally to as much as 3.8 percent alcohol, about the strength of beer. For their body weight, the treeshrews take in as much as a person drinking nine glasses of wine in an evening, and hair tests for the alcohol marker ethyl glucuronide confirmed it. They showed no sign of intoxication. The study appeared in PNAS in 2008; its lead author thinks the alcohol is how the palm attracts mammals as pollinators.
Which animal has the strangest diet?
